posts.text:
https://t.co/gFu88pnFdV just crossed $3K MRR 🥳

Growth was flat for 2 weeks because I rejected about 40% of new users.

I'm following the advice of the Yoda of email, @jessethanley: if I want to build a long-term business, I need to be obsessed with deliverability.

The problem with newsletter tools is shared reputation: a few people abusing the system drag everyone else down. One user sending cold emails can kill deliverability for everyone else on the platform.

So I spent 2 weeks tightening everything. Import file names, newsletter content, subdomain names, subscriber emails, open rates: everything gets checked, mostly by AI. Users who aren't crystal clean get blocked.

My goal is to serve a few very high-quality customers for decades.
posts.text_zh:
https://t.co/gFu88pnFdV 刚突破 $3K MRR 🥳

过去两周增长几乎持平，因为我拒绝了大约 40% 的新用户。

我在听从邮件界的 Yoda——@jessethanley 的建议：如果我想做一家长期生意，就必须对送达率（deliverability）执着到极致。

newsletter 工具的问题在于共享信誉：少数滥用系统的人会拖累所有人。一个用户发冷邮件，就可能毁掉平台上其他人的送达率。

所以我花了两周把所有环节都收紧了。导入文件名、newsletter 内容、子域域名、订阅者邮箱、打开率：每一样都会检查，主要靠 AI。不够干净的用户会被拦截。

我的目标是服务少数非常高质量的客户，而且要服务几十年。

It starts on November 16, and you'll have 30 days to build a startup and make it profitable. The prizes:

🥇 $100,000
🥈 iPhone Duo
🥉 MacBook Neo
